The Promise

Security isn't a product we sell.
It's trust we're accountable for.

PYX Security Services has run continuous operations since 1991 — from a guarding provider into a total security and technology partner.

Our people are predominantly ex-armed-forces: police-verified, NADRA-checked, and APSAA-certified in weapons handling before they're ever posted. If a loss results from the negligence of our own deployed staff, PYX indemnifies the client for it — a promise most guarding firms won't put in writing.

Manned Guarding & Patrols

IT & Technology Solutions

Manpower Outsourcing

Housekeeping, watchmen, and other vetted non-guarding staff.
